segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Karen, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the calibration management rollout scope before I send the order form. Last we had 38 technician seats and 12 manager seats for the Ohio and Indiana labs, is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that is right. We may add two more technicians in March, but for the January go-live, 50 seats total is the number.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. For pricing, the annual subscription for 50 seats is $42,600, and the implementation package is a one-time $7,500. That includes the instrument import, three admin training sessions, and the barcode label template work.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance asked whether the implementation fee can be invoiced in January instead of on signature. Our budget opens January 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can set the subscription start date as January 15, 2026 and invoice the implementation fee on January 2. The annual subscription invoice would go out at signature with net 30 terms, unless you need both invoices in January.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's do both in January. Signature will probably be next week, but AP prefers not to see it until the new year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I’ll write the billing schedule that way: first invoice January 2 for $50,100 total, net 30. Renewal date would be January 15, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On contract terms, we need the same three-year price hold you mentioned, but we only want to commit one year at a time.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, so a one-year initial term with two optional annual renewals, and the seat price held through January 2029 as long as renewal is completed before the term end. No automatic increase built in.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Go-live is still January 15, and we need the legacy instrument list loaded by January 8 so our quality manager can spot check it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I have that captured: import file due from you by December 19, loaded by January 8, admin training on January 9, 12, and 13. If you send the PO contact, I’ll include the invoicing and go-live details in the order form today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send it to me and copy billing at our shared AP address. If the numbers match what you just said, I can route it for signature Monday.
